prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic candid film-style portrait of an approved adult woman on a boat at golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length wavy reddish-brown/copper hair, windblown strands and sun-kissed highlights, light blue-green eyes, fair natural skin with light freckles, and calm serene expression. She faces away but turns her head over the left shoulder toward camera, wearing a simple white slip dress or top with thin crystal-embellished straps and elegant open back.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up or medium over-shoulder portrait, subject framed against expansive blue water, distant coastline and bright sky, partial white boat structure at left softly out of focus, face and hair as focal point.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm late-afternoon/golden-hour side light, soft facial shadows, bright hair and shoulder highlights, breezy summery peaceful nostalgic cinematic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50-85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, shallow water/coast bokeh, high-definition realistic skin and hair, subtle natural film grain, square or 4:5 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic candid film-style portrait of an approved adult woman on a boat at golden hour. She has shoulder-length wavy reddish-brown/copper hair with windblown strands and sun-kissed highlights, light blue-green eyes, fair natural skin with light freckles, and a calm serene expression. She faces away from the camera but turns her head over the left shoulder to look directly at the lens, wearing a simple white slip dress or top with thin crystal-embellished straps and an elegant open back. prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
